subject: gse/navier-stokes
body: Navier-Stokes BKM multi-grid convergence sweep complete: 27 cases over Nr,Nz in {32,64,128} x nu in {0.005,0.05,0.0}. Triadic phase lock holds at every step of every case (max R=2.58e-13); Euler control shows zero numerical dissipation (ratio 1.000000, 9/9). HONEST NEGATIVE: monotone peak-vorticity decay holds in 9/27 cases and all 9 are inviscid where nothing decays -- the radial collocation is non-dissipative on high-wavenumber near-pole modes (genuine positive eigenvalues, confirmed in longdouble, scaling as Nr^4), so 15/27 cases diverge. Physics suite 15/15, SGP 26/26.
